entry.title: Agno
entry.summary: Build AI agents with memory, knowledge and tools. Python framework for production agents, formerly Phidata.

entry.title: Algorithm Visualizer
entry.summary: Interactive animations of algorithms and data structures, with the code beside them. The hosted demo is offline, so this runs locally.

entry.title: Arena AI
entry.summary: Head-to-head LLM comparisons with blind voting. The most credible LLM benchmark based on human preference.

entry.title: Awesome Windows 11
entry.summary: Curated list of the best apps, tools, tweaks, and resources for Windows 11. Community-maintained on GitHub.

entry.title: Fail2ban
entry.summary: Intrusion prevention that bans IPs showing malicious signs. Monitors logs and updates firewall rules automatically.

entry.title: FMHY SafeGuard
entry.summary: Browser extension that warns you about unsafe or malicious sites. Community-maintained blocklist based on FMHY's unsafe sites list.

entry.title: Gitpod
entry.summary: Self-hostable cloud development environments. Spin up a full dev workspace from any Git repo. The company now trades as Ona; the AGPL project kept the name.

entry.title: Krea.ai
entry.summary: Real-time AI image generation. See results update as you type. Canvas mode for editing.

entry.title: Lens
entry.summary: The Kubernetes IDE. Manage clusters, workloads, and Helm charts with a beautiful desktop app.

entry.title: LibRedirect
entry.summary: Browser extension that redirects popular sites to privacy-respecting frontends (Invidious, Nitter, etc.).

entry.title: Maltego
entry.summary: Visual link analysis for OSINT investigations. Map relationships between people, companies, domains and IPs. The Community Edition is still free.

entry.title: PhoneInfoga
entry.summary: Advanced information gathering tool for phone numbers. Scan international numbers with multiple sources.

entry.title: Plex
entry.summary: Organize and stream your personal media library. Movies, TV, music and photos, beautifully presented.

entry.title: Poolsuite
entry.summary: Retro-styled internet radio and video player. 90s aesthetics, vaporwave vibes, poolside relaxation.

entry.title: public-apis
entry.summary: Massive categorized list of free APIs covering weather, music, sports and finance. If it exists, there's an API for it.

entry.title: Seerr
entry.summary: Media request management for Plex. Users browse and request films and shows; you approve. Formerly Overseerr.

entry.title: Soundtrap
entry.summary: Online collaborative music studio. Record, mix, and share music directly in the browser.

entry.title: SpiderFoot
entry.summary: Open source OSINT automation. Scans 200+ data sources to map an entity's digital footprint.

entry.title: Cloudflare Tunnel
entry.summary: Expose local services to the internet securely without port forwarding. Free, encrypted, and zero-trust.

entry.title: Docuseal
entry.summary: Open source document signing platform. Create, fill, and sign documents. DocuSign alternative.

entry.title: jq
entry.summary: Command-line JSON processor. Slice, filter, map, and transform JSON data. Essential for API work.

entry.title: Llamafile
entry.summary: Single-file executable LLMs. Download one file and run a chatbot. No Python, no Docker, no dependencies.

entry.title: Mozilla Observatory
entry.summary: Mozilla's website security scanner. Tests headers, TLS, cookies, and content security policies.

entry.title: Paint.NET
entry.summary: Fast, intuitive image editor for Windows. Layers, effects, plugins, and GPU acceleration. Lighter than Photoshop, more powerful than Paint.

entry.title: Runway
entry.summary: Creative AI toolkit for video. Gen-3 Alpha for video generation, motion brush, green screen, and more.

entry.title: Stirling PDF
entry.summary: Self-hosted PDF toolkit. Merge, split, rotate, compress, OCR and convert. Every PDF operation in one tool.

entry.title: Terraform
entry.summary: Infrastructure as code. Define cloud resources in declarative config files. The industry standard.

entry.title: tldr pages
entry.summary: Simplified, community-driven man pages. Practical examples for every command. Cut the noise.

entry.title: Trilium Notes
entry.summary: Hierarchical note-taking app with powerful scripting. Relation maps, book notes, task management. Self-hostable.

entry.title: VeraCrypt
entry.summary: Disk encryption software based on TrueCrypt. Create encrypted volumes, encrypt entire drives, or set up hidden operating systems.

entry.title: Agent QA
entry.summary: Natural-language web and mobile regression QA with CLI and MCP workflows, retained artifacts, and failure triage.
